entities.name: Rakka Mar
entities.description: A female human shaman from Jund who summoned elementals and served Nicol Bolas as a minion.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: The shard of Alara where Rakka Mar lived, home to human war clans and the Life Hunt.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane that contains the shard of Jund.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker who lured Rakka Mar with the promise of more power and used her influence on Jund.

entities.name: Kresh the Bloodbraided
entities.description: Leader of a human clan on Jund whom Rakka Mar convinced to hunt a hellkite.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who offered his aid against the dragon and was later presented to Nicol Bolas by Rakka.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker who sought Rakka Mar for information about Nicol Bolas and killed her.

entities.name: Life Hunt
entities.description: The hunts pursued by the human clans of Jund, which Rakka promoted on Bolas's behalf.

entities.name: Jund's Obelisk
entities.description: An Obelisk on Jund that Rakka revealed at the dragon's lair.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas lures Rakka Mar with the promise of more magical power, and she uses her influence among Jund's human war clans to promote greater Life Hunts.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas saw the potential in Rakka Mar immediately and lured her with the promise of more magical power.

events.summary: Rakka Mar gains dark powers of elementalism from her bond with Bolas.
events.quote: In return, Rakka gained dark powers of elementalism the likes of which she had never felt before.

events.summary: Rakka convinces Kresh and his clan to hunt a hellkite; on the way her stone elementals defeat attacking viashino, and they meet Sarkhan Vol.
events.quote: They also caught up with Sarkhan Vol , who offered his aid in confronting the dragon.

events.summary: At the dragon's lair Rakka betrays the Jundians, using them as bait while she reveals Jund's Obelisk.
events.quote: Rakka betrayed the Jundians and used them as bait while she revealed Jund's Obelisk

events.summary: Rakka saves Sarkhan Vol and presents her master Nicol Bolas to him.
events.quote: Later, she saved Sarkhan Vol and presented to him her master, Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Ajani and Kresh's clan seek out Rakka for information about Bolas; she nearly kills Kresh with thunder-like energy.
events.quote: Rakka almost killed Kresh with powerful thunder-like energy

events.summary: Ajani, tempted by her offer, kills Rakka Mar with a bolt of rage.
events.quote: Ajani was tempted by this offering but ultimately killed Rakka with a mighty bolt of rage.

relations.note: Rakka knew her status as a minion of Bolas.
relations.quote: She knew her status as a minion

relations.note: Ajani killed Rakka with a bolt of rage.
relations.quote: Ajani was tempted by this offering but ultimately killed Rakka with a mighty bolt of rage.
Rakka Mar was a female human shaman from Jund , Alara who specialized in summoning elementals .
